ideas.title: Autonomous AMM operated by an AI agent
ideas.summary: Market-making bot that signs Sui transactions via its own capability, with a transparent strategy auditable on chain.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored transactions remove gas friction for high-frequency rebalancing. Capabilities scope the agent's authority precisely.
ideas.marketSignal: AI x DeFi is a recurring theme in YC and a16z theses; no Sui-native equivalent exists yet.

ideas.title: AI agents with their own Sui-native wallets and capabilities
ideas.summary: Framework for AI agents that hold capabilities, pay for compute and data via on-chain ops, and produce verifiable receipts.
ideas.fitForSui: Capabilities give agents granular permissions. Sponsored gas hides crypto from agent-facing flows.
ideas.marketSignal: Agent-native infra is one of the most consistent VC theses for 2026.

ideas.title: Capability-based key management
ideas.summary: Granular keys per app per scope, on-chain verifiable, revocable. Sigstore-shape but for Sui.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's capability primitive natively expresses scoped authority; no equivalent on EVM or Solana.
ideas.marketSignal: Key management is a top developer pain across web3; no on-chain capability-native solution today.

ideas.title: Composable membership and role contracts
ideas.summary: A user's membership object carries capabilities other apps verify without integration. One object, many frontends.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model lets membership state travel across apps with no integration handshake. EVM tokens cannot carry capabilities.
ideas.marketSignal: Loyalty and membership is a $300B+ category; existing crypto memberships do not compose across apps.

ideas.title: Composable DeFi strategies as PTB recipes
ideas.summary: Library of pre-composed PTBs (borrow on Scallop, swap on Cetus, deposit to Aftermath). User picks a recipe, signs once.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs let multiple protocol calls atomic-execute in one signature. EVM equivalent requires custom router contracts per recipe.
ideas.marketSignal: DeFi UX complexity is the leading abandonment cause in user research; one-signature flows are a known win.

ideas.title: Cross-marketplace kiosk listings
ideas.summary: List an item once, surface on every kiosk-aware frontend. Marketplaces compete on UX, not on inventory.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui Kiosk standard is a shared protocol, not a per-marketplace silo. EVM marketplaces fragment liquidity.
ideas.marketSignal: Cross-marketplace listing on EVM (OpenSea Pro, Blur) shows clear demand; Sui Kiosk makes it native.

ideas.title: Dark pools on DeepBook
ideas.summary: Batched matching, MEV-resistant venue for large orders. Settles via DeepBook's CLOB.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's on-chain CLOB enables batched settlement with verifiable fairness. AMMs leak intent to MEV.
ideas.marketSignal: Institutional crypto demand consistently asks for dark pools; CowSwap proves the model on EVM.

ideas.title: Encrypted file vault on Walrus
ideas.summary: End-to-end encrypted file storage. Walrus stores ciphertext, Sui access policy via capabilities.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus provides cheap blob storage; Sui capabilities express access scopes natively.
ideas.marketSignal: Personal cloud storage is a $100B+ category; consumers are skeptical of central custody.

ideas.title: Limit-order UI for any token pair
ideas.summary: CLOB-style trading UX for users who want price control instead of AMM slippage.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook supports limit orders natively. AMM-only UIs leak value to slippage and MEV.
ideas.marketSignal: Centralized exchanges remain the majority of crypto volume because CLOB UX is preferred for size.

ideas.title: Lending against NFT and kiosk-object collateral
ideas.summary: Money market that accepts composable Sui objects as collateral, not just fungible tokens.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects carry richer state than ERC-721; oracle and liquidation logic can read object fields directly.
ideas.marketSignal: NFT lending on EVM (Blur, Arcade) demonstrates demand; Sui-native composability makes it deeper.

ideas.title: Marketplace for non-NFT Sui objects
ideas.summary: Domains, memberships, certifications, professional licenses listed on a kiosk-style marketplace.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk works for any object, not just visual NFTs. EVM marketplaces are NFT-only.
ideas.marketSignal: Domain markets ($BNS, Unstoppable) prove demand; memberships and certifications are still off-chain.

ideas.title: Object-as-passport apps
ideas.summary: Event tickets, memberships, certifications that travel across multiple frontends because the object is the source of truth.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects are app-agnostic. EVM tokens require per-app integrations to be useful elsewhere.
ideas.marketSignal: Ticketing fraud is a billion-dollar problem; portable ownership is a known consumer ask.

ideas.title: On-chain customer support tools
ideas.summary: Every support ticket creates a sponsored on-chain object. Support team and user can both audit. Disputes have receipts.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored transactions hide gas. Object-as-record means both parties have shared truth.
ideas.marketSignal: Support fraud and chargeback friction is well documented; verifiable receipts are an unmet need.

ideas.title: On-chain receipts as a service
ideas.summary: User signs in with Google. App sponsors gas. Every purchase becomes a kiosk receipt. Returns and warranties verifiable on chain.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin plus sponsored tx means consumers never see crypto. Kiosk holds the receipt.
ideas.marketSignal: Receipt and warranty fraud is a known retail loss vector; consumers want digital proof.

ideas.title: Pay-per-use SaaS that bills in fiat, settles on Sui
ideas.summary: Consumer-facing SaaS where Stripe collects USD, the backend settles on-chain via sponsored Sui transactions, every action emits a verifiable record.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored gas means users never see a wallet. Sui settles verifiably for the merchant's audit trail.
ideas.marketSignal: SaaS billing transparency is an unmet ask in B2B; verifiable usage is a regulatory tailwind.

ideas.title: One-tap on-chain games
ideas.summary: Mobile-first games where every action is sponsored, no wallet popups, identity is Google or Apple sign-in.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin plus sponsored tx removes every consumer friction point. Sui's parallel execution handles game throughput.
ideas.marketSignal: Mobile crypto gaming has had repeated near-hits; the missing piece has been UX, not chain throughput.

ideas.title: Permanent personal memory and journal app
ideas.summary: User's writing, photos, and voice notes stored on Walrus. Sui access control. Optional social layer.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus blob pricing makes long-form personal storage viable on chain. EVM storage is too expensive.
ideas.marketSignal: Day-One and Journey are profitable consumer apps; permanence is a known value prop.

ideas.title: Perpetuals using DeepBook as the settlement venue
ideas.summary: Perp protocol where DeepBook is the on-chain settlement layer instead of a custom AMM.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook's CLOB makes funding-rate computation cheap on chain and avoids AMM impermanent-loss problems.
ideas.marketSignal: Perp DEX volume on Sui remains thin compared to EVM; market share is contestable.

ideas.title: Decentralized podcast and video host on Walrus
ideas.summary: Walrus stores episodes, Sui handles creator economics (subscriptions, tips, splits via capability objects).
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus pricing makes long-form audio and video viable; Sui objects model creator splits cleanly.
ideas.marketSignal: Creator-economics platforms (Patreon, Substack) prove demand; on-chain royalty splits are a known ask.

ideas.title: Truly walletless social apps
ideas.summary: Google or Apple sign-in is the wallet. Sponsored gas hides every on-chain action.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin plus sponsored transactions is Sui's most differentiated wedge. EVM social apps require seed phrases.
ideas.marketSignal: Friend.tech, Lens, and Farcaster prove social app demand; wallet UX has been the friction.

ideas.title: Provenance-verified AI training datasets
ideas.summary: Datasets stored on Walrus, licensed and sold via Sui. Buyers get verifiable provenance and revocable access.
ideas.fitForSui: Walrus provides the storage layer; Sui capabilities express dataset licenses cleanly.
ideas.marketSignal: AI dataset licensing is a multi-billion-dollar market with active legal disputes about provenance.

ideas.title: Yield aggregator across Scallop, NAVI, and Suilend
ideas.summary: Single deposit, optimized routing across Sui money markets. Auto-rebalances on rate changes.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs make multi-protocol routing atomic. Sponsored upkeep transactions remove user-side friction.
ideas.marketSignal: Yearn-shape aggregators have product-market fit on EVM; no Sui-native equivalent at scale.
